name: Filesystem
description: Read, write, edit, move and search files and directories on disk. Wraps the official @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem — every operation is confined to the folders you allow, and paths outside them are refused. Set the allowed roots in this pack's config before use.

root.description: Folder the buttons may read and write. Everything outside it is refused — point this at a project or documents folder, NOT at / or your home directory.
